Pax Lazarus is a dark philosophy centered on redemption, resilience, and the sanctity of life after suffering. It portrays death not as an end, but as a path to transformation and healing through inner strength, compassion, and self-sacrifice. In this worldview, peace comes not from avoiding darkness, but from embracing it and choosing life regardless.

The Church of Light is a radiant, dogmatic faith devoted to purity, order, and divine justice. It views the world in absolutes—light versus darkness, sin versus virtue—and seeks to cleanse corruption through strict moral discipline and divine will. In this worldview, salvation comes through obedience, sacrifice, and unwavering faith in the sacred light.
Holy city of Kelebrion, capital of Kelebrion Kingdom.

text.us: Hello, Stan!
Hello.
Hello, Lizzy <3
How are you doing?
I'm ok.
Let's go!
How are you, my dear Stan?
I'm doing ok, Lizzy. What about you?
I missed you

text.us:
The Holy Kingdom of Light — Kelebrion.
Once blessed by the Lord of Light and the Angels...
But now...

Goblins have invaded our sacred lands...
And the wise know...
This is only the beginning.

After a long, perilous journey,
To atone for your sins,
To reclaim your honor,
Your right to be called a knight,
You have finally reached the borders
Of your homeland...

Only to see that the servants of Light
Can no longer defend
All you hold dear,
All those you swore to protect.

You are Lord Stan Walsey, once the youngest knight in the proud history of Kelebrion.
But your fury… your hatred for the enemies of Light led you down the Path of Blood.
Your sovereign, Richard the Lightbringer, exiled you — not out of punishment, but in hope that your soul might be redeemed.
Now, after all this time... Everything you see tells you one thing: the Might of Blood is needed once more.
To protect the weak, to destroy the creatures of darkness, and yet… the line between the two seems thinner than ever. Are they truly different?
